title: Lovely Roasted Canadian Portobello Mushrooms Skewers
description: A delicious and shattering date-night dish featuring roasted portobello mushrooms with a touch of celery salt, perfect for a vegan-friendly dinner

ingredients.name: Portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and celery salt
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each mushroom
Grill the mushroom skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are tender and lightly charred
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute
